namespace = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion

###############
# Side effects from Conversion
# 2000-2999
###############

###Bad Side Effects


#Resistance to conversion
# by Petter Vilberg
kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.2001 = {
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		exists = cp:councillor_court_chaplain
		scope:councillor = cp:councillor_court_chaplain
		scope:councillor = {
			learning < high_skill_rating
		}
        scope:councillor = { has_variable = kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province }
		scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province = {
			NOT = { has_province_modifier = kCAFG_court_chaplain_resisted_conversion_modifier }
		}
	}

	weight_multiplier = {
		base = 1
		compare_modifier = {
			target = scope:councillor
			value = learning
			multiplier = -0.2
			offset = inverted_high_skill_rating
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		cp:councillor_court_chaplain = {
			save_scope_as = active_councillor
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = had_court_chaplain_task_side_effect
			value = yes
			days = court_chaplain_task_side_effect_cooldown
		}
		send_interface_message = {
			type = msg_court_chaplain_task_bad
			title = court_chaplain_task.2001.notification
			desc = {
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { learning <= average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_learning_bad_unskilled_notification_tooltip
				}
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { learning > average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_learning_bad_skilled_notification_tooltip
				}
			}
			tooltip = task_conversion_notification_tooltip
			left_icon = scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province.barony
			right_icon = scope:councillor

            scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province = {
				add_province_modifier = {
					modifier = kCAFG_court_chaplain_resisted_conversion_modifier
					days = court_chaplain_task_modifier_duration
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

#Upset over conversion
# by Petter Vilberg
kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.2002 = {
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		exists = cp:councillor_court_chaplain
		scope:councillor = cp:councillor_court_chaplain
		scope:councillor = {
			learning < high_skill_rating
		}
        scope:councillor = { has_variable = kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province }
		scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province = {
			NOR = {
				has_province_modifier = kCAFG_court_chaplain_county_conversion_upset_modifier
				has_province_modifier = kCAFG_court_chaplain_county_conversion_support_modifier
			}
		}
	}

	weight_multiplier = {
		base = 1
		compare_modifier = {
			target = scope:councillor
			value = learning
			multiplier = -0.2
			offset = inverted_high_skill_rating
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		cp:councillor_court_chaplain = {
			save_scope_as = active_councillor
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = had_court_chaplain_task_side_effect
			value = yes
			days = court_chaplain_task_side_effect_cooldown
		}
		send_interface_message = {
			type = msg_court_chaplain_task_bad
			title = court_chaplain_task.2002.notification
			desc = {
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { learning <= average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_learning_bad_unskilled_notification_tooltip
				}
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { learning > average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_learning_bad_skilled_notification_tooltip
				}
			}
			tooltip = task_conversion_notification_tooltip

			left_icon = scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province.barony
			right_icon = scope:councillor

            scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province = {
                custom_tooltip = {
                    text = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion_events_faith_tension_increase_tooltip
                    change_variable = {
                        name = kCAFG_faith_tension
                        add = V_kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversions_tension_increase
                    }
                    E_kCAFG_on_province_faith_tension_updated = yes
                }
				add_province_modifier = {
					modifier = kCAFG_court_chaplain_county_conversion_upset_modifier
					days = court_chaplain_task_modifier_duration
				}
			}
		}
	}
}


###Good Side Effects



#Improve County opinion
# by Petter Vilberg

kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.2101 = {
	hidden = yes
	
	trigger = {
		exists = cp:councillor_court_chaplain
		scope:councillor = cp:councillor_court_chaplain
		scope:councillor = {
			learning > mediocre_skill_rating
		}
        scope:councillor = { has_variable = kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province }
		scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province = {
			NOR = {
				has_province_modifier = kCAFG_court_chaplain_county_conversion_upset_modifier
				has_province_modifier = kCAFG_court_chaplain_county_conversion_support_modifier
			}
		}
	}

	weight_multiplier = {
		base = 1
		compare_modifier = {
			target = scope:councillor
			value = learning
			multiplier = 0.2
			offset = inverted_mediocre_skill_rating
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		cp:councillor_court_chaplain = {
			save_scope_as = active_councillor
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = had_court_chaplain_task_side_effect
			value = yes
			days = court_chaplain_task_side_effect_cooldown
		}
		send_interface_message = {
			type = msg_court_chaplain_task_good
			title = court_chaplain_task.2101.notification
			desc = {
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { learning <= average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_learning_good_unskilled_notification_tooltip
				}
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { learning > average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_learning_good_skilled_notification_tooltip
				}
			}
			tooltip = task_conversion_notification_tooltip

			left_icon = scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province.barony
			right_icon = scope:councillor

		    scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province = {
                custom_tooltip = {
                    text = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion_events_faith_tension_decrease_tooltip
                    change_variable = {
                        name = kCAFG_faith_tension
                        add = V_kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversions_tension_decrease
                    }
                    E_kCAFG_on_province_faith_tension_updated = yes
                }
				add_province_modifier = {
					modifier = kCAFG_court_chaplain_county_conversion_support_modifier
					days = court_chaplain_task_modifier_duration
				}
			}
		}
	}
}


#Increased County Development
# by Petter Vilberg

kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.2102 = {
	hidden = yes
	
	trigger = {
		exists = cp:councillor_court_chaplain
		scope:councillor = cp:councillor_court_chaplain
		scope:councillor = {
			learning > mediocre_skill_rating
		}
        scope:councillor = { has_variable = kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province }
		scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province = {
			NOT = { has_province_modifier = kCAFG_court_chaplain_religious_construction_modifier }
		}
	}

	weight_multiplier = {
		base = 1
		compare_modifier = {
			target = scope:councillor
			value = learning
			multiplier = 0.2
			offset = inverted_mediocre_skill_rating
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		cp:councillor_court_chaplain = {
			save_scope_as = active_councillor
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = had_court_chaplain_task_side_effect
			value = yes
			days = court_chaplain_task_side_effect_cooldown
		}
		send_interface_message = {
			type = msg_court_chaplain_task_good
			title = court_chaplain_task.2102.notification
			desc = {
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { learning <= average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_learning_good_unskilled_notification_tooltip
				}
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { learning > average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_learning_good_skilled_notification_tooltip
				}
			}
			tooltip = task_conversion_notification_tooltip

			left_icon = scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province.barony
			right_icon = scope:councillor

		    scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province = {
				add_province_modifier = {
					modifier = kCAFG_court_chaplain_religious_construction_modifier
					days = court_chaplain_task_modifier_duration
				}
			}
		}
	}
}


#Increased County Levies
# by Petter Vilberg

kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.2103 = {
	hidden = yes
	
	trigger = {
		exists = cp:councillor_court_chaplain
		scope:councillor = cp:councillor_court_chaplain
		scope:councillor = {
			learning > mediocre_skill_rating
		}
        scope:councillor = { has_variable = kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province }
		scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province = {
			NOT = { has_province_modifier = kCAFG_court_chaplain_religious_fervor_modifier }
		}
	}

	weight_multiplier = {
		base = 1
		compare_modifier = {
			target = scope:councillor
			value = learning
			multiplier = 0.2
			offset = inverted_mediocre_skill_rating
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		cp:councillor_court_chaplain = {
			save_scope_as = active_councillor
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = had_court_chaplain_task_side_effect
			value = yes
			days = court_chaplain_task_side_effect_cooldown
		}
		send_interface_message = {
			type = msg_court_chaplain_task_good
			title = court_chaplain_task.2103.notification
			desc = {
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { learning <= average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_learning_good_unskilled_notification_tooltip
				}
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { learning > average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_learning_good_skilled_notification_tooltip
				}
			}
			tooltip = task_conversion_notification_tooltip

			left_icon = scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province.barony
			right_icon = scope:councillor

		    scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province = {
				add_province_modifier = {
					modifier = kCAFG_court_chaplain_religious_fervor_modifier
					days = court_chaplain_task_modifier_duration
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

#Court chaplain deems conversion unnecessary
kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001 = {
	type = letter_event
	opening = {
		desc = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001.opening
	}
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:focused_province = { T_kCAFG_province_only_faith = { FAITH = scope:councillor_liege.faith } } }
				desc = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001.desc_complete
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:focused_province = { var:kCAFG_target_faith_tension <= V_kCAFG_AI_suggestion_task_conversion_tension_threshold } }
				desc = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001.desc_tension
			}
			desc = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001.desc
		}
	}
	sender = scope:councillor

	immediate = {
		scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_conversion_focused_province = { save_scope_as = focused_province }
		scope:focused_province = { 
			# Parameters
			save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_set_default_focus_excluded_province
			save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_set_default_focus_can_redirect
			save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_set_default_focus_ai_select_for_liege
			#
			county = { E_kCAFG_task_conversion_select_default_focus = yes }
		}
	}

	# I'll let you decide
	option = {
		name = {
			text = {
				first_valid = {
					triggered_desc = {
						trigger = { scope:focused_province = { T_kCAFG_province_only_faith = { FAITH = scope:councillor_liege.faith } } }
						desc = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001.a_complete
					}
					desc = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001.a
				}
			}
		}
		trigger = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:focused_province
					exists = scope:kCAFG_selected_province_to_focus
					scope:councillor = { has_council_position = councillor_court_chaplain }
				}
				always = yes
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001.a.tt
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:councillor = {
				E_kCAFG_task_conversion_set_focus = { PROVINCE = scope:kCAFG_selected_province_to_focus }
				clear_saved_scope = kCAFG_selected_province_to_focus
			}
		}
		ai_chance = 1
	}

	# Keep it up
	option = {
		trigger = {
			scope:councillor = { is_performing_council_task = task_conversion }
			scope:focused_province = { NOT = { T_kCAFG_province_only_faith = { FAITH = scope:councillor_liege.faith } } }
		}
		name = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001.b
		custom_tooltip = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001.b.tt
		hidden_effect = { scope:councillor = { set_variable = kCAFG_court_chaplain_conversion_finish_focus } }
		ai_chance = 1
	}

	#Set to default task
	option = {
		name = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001.c
		custom_tooltip = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001.c.tt
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:councillor = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_council_position = councillor_court_chaplain }
					start_default_task = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = 1
	}

	# Don't bother me
	option = {
		name = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001.d
		custom_tooltip = kCAFG_court_chaplain_task_conversion.9001.d.tt
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = kCAFG_ignore_court_chaplain_conversion_suggestions }
		ai_chance = 1
	}
}
